images.seen: West Asia matches Cliopatria except by design: Median outline cut back to the Halys, Urartu still drawn (olive) but 433 of its cells go to the Medes on 1 Jan -600 by R2, ten years before Van falls in 590; Neo-Babylon holds the upper Tigris and Harran; Elam inside Median land; Punjab/Ganges janapadas drawn larger than Cliopatria's dots.

Achaemenid empire drawn from Halys to the Hindu Kush without Central Asia (comes in with the -540 ledger) and with a hole in Iranian Baluchestan (519 cells Cliopatria has in -500 but no ledger event gave); Neo-Babylon and Lihyan occupation hatch right; Scythia, Lydia and Qedar plausible.

Italy and Greece fine: Etruscans with Po plain and Corsica later, Veneti, Umbri, Sabines, Latin League, Sybaris/Taras/Messapii as small winners over the Greek aggregate; Lydia holds a solid block with the Greek coast as one-cell strips (they flip from Lydian to Greek in -550 and to Persian in -547).

Levant and north Arabia: Neo-Babylon holds Syria, Palestine, Edom and the Euphrates; Phoenicia and Moab drawn as vassal tint; Lihyan hatched as occupied; Tayma (Nabonidus' seat, 30 cells in Tabuk) is blank because the -550 keyframe drops it; Cyprus is Achaemenid teal already in -545.

China: Wu jumps to 906 cells (Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang) with Xu squeezed to half its land inside it (R2 misfire; patched) and Chu's Anhui part cut off (Wu's 584 western offensive: kept); the rest of the Zhou states, Jin with a hole, Qi, Lu, Ju, Song, Zheng, Cai, Chen all sit as expected; Yiqu a huge olive block north of Qin.

End of window: Achaemenid empire complete from Thrace to the Indus with Hindush, Gandara, Yehud, Qedar as tinted dependants; Persian Egypt hatched along the Nile with the Western Desert as plain Achaemenid; Sistan and Baluchestan blank in the draft (fixed by events/0); Cyrene, Macedon tinted.

issues.what: Urartu's land handed to the Medes ten years early: the Median -600 keyframe (Anatolia up to the Halys, ledger/6's undated guess) overlaps Urartu, and R2 (median succeeds urartu) gave Median 404-433 Urartian cells on 1 Jan -600, although Urartu's own dossier and the page end Urartu when Van falls in 590. The size rule never saw it (R2 first), so no ruling could fix it.

Xu's heartland (47 of its 94 cells) given to Wu in 584 by R2 (wu succeeds xu) because Cliopatria's Wu outline covers it from 750 to 480; the Xu page has Xu attacked in 584 but 'conquered by Wu in 512 BC'. Needed both wu_-584 and wu_-550 (Cliopatria's Wu shape is the same in -584 and -550 and would snap onto Xu again); the -512 gain event hands the land over.

Iranian Baluchestan and Makran (Gedrosia), 519 cells inside Cliopatria's Achaemenid outline of -500, stay unowned from the empire's founding until the -500 keyframe snap: ledger/7 names Afghanistan to Kyrgyzstan and ledger/13 (Indus, 515) only Pakistan, so Sistan and Baluchestan falls between. The Gedrosia page says 'conquered by Cyrus the Great or Darius the Great' with no year; placed at 515 with Darius's Indus campaign, confidence 1. Drangiana (Sistan proper) was already drawn.

Qataban's 52 cells (Wadi Bayhan, with Marib and Shabwah cells) disappear at -550: sabaeans/ledger/7 gives Saba Qataban's land, but the sabaeans_-550 and sabaeans_-450 keyframes (Cliopatria shape without Qataban) snap it away, so the land stays unowned until Qataban's own -420 keyframe (Qataban 52 cells at -551, 0 at -500). Page: Qataban 'had come under the control of Saba' in the 6th century and regained independence in the late 5th.

Chu / Wu 39 cells of Anhui at -584 (Wu wins by size) and Wu holding 826 cells from -584: the Xu page says Chu's dominance over the Huai valley was broken in 584 by a large-scale Wu offensive, which fits Wu holding the Huai cells; the Wu page gives no border and does not mention Zhoulai.

Mainland Ionian/Aeolian coast (about 27 cells, one-cell strips): Lydia holds them from -560 (Croesus 'subjugated all of mainland Ionia, Aeolis, and Doris'), the greek-city-states_-550 snap hands them back to the poleis for -550..-548, then Persia has them from -547. A ruling for Lydia alone leaves 30 cells unowned to -542 because lydia_-550 (Cliopatria shape without the coast) then snaps them off; a full fix is three entries (lydia_-550 plus coast, greek_-550 minus coast, an Achaemenid -547 gain from Lydia needing the Ionia page). Cosmetic, left.
issues.decision: left: pages silent on the coast's status in 550 beyond Croesus' conquest; cosmetic

issues.what: Median Kingdom / Neo-Babylonian Empire, 353 cell-years at -600 (Diyarbakir, Sanliurfa, Van, Mardin): Babylon wins as the smaller; the Median dossier itself says the page gives no partition of Assyria, and Cliopatria draws the upper Tigris and Harran as Babylonian (Babylonia took Transpotamia in 609).

Other size-rule conflicts looked at and right as drawn: Cyrene/Barca over the Greek aggregate in Libya, Sybaris, Taras, Messapii, Croton, Akragas, Massalia over the aggregate, Elam over Media in Khuzestan, Qedar over Babylon, Phoenicia over Babylon, the Indian janapadas over the Painted Grey Ware culture (which ends 1 Jan -600), Kush/27th dynasty at Aswan.

Tayma (Nabonidus' seat from c. 553 to c. 543, 30 cells in Tabuk) is given by neo-babylonian-empire/ledger/9 and removed by the -550 keyframe snap (Cliopatria's shape lacks it); the Lihyan occupation hatch still shows the Babylonian presence. Keeping it would need overrides of both -550 and -540 keyframes.
issues.decision: left: pages silent beyond the dossier's own quote (page not opened), 30 cells

issues.what: Persian Egypt: the 27th dynasty (Nile Valley, 479 cells) is drawn as occupied (the scope's convention), while the other cells of the 26th dynasty's outline inside Egypt (Western Desert and Red Sea coast, 478 cells at the end) go to the Achaemenid empire direct by achaemenid ledger/12; the picture is hatch along the Nile and solid teal beside it.
issues.decision: left: pages silent; two dossiers give different regions for the same satrapy

issues.what: Cyprus is drawn Achaemenid from the -550 keyframe (Cliopatria's 550 outline includes it) to -541, dropped by the -540 snap (14 cells) and regained by ledger/10 in -525 from the 26th dynasty ('seized from Amasis II'); the ledger puts it in Egyptian hands until 525.

Scythia, Lydia, Median and Achaemenid ledgers for -550..-515 (Persian conquests of Media, Lydia, Elam, Babylon, Egypt, Indus) and the Indian janapadas, Etruscans, Greek colonies, Carthage as drawn: no jump without an event other than the ones above.

problems: keyframe_overrides/4 (sabaeans_-450, years -450..-384) lies in the next window m0500-m0401; applied with a note. It repeats the -550 fix because the -450 snap would otherwise drop Qataban's 52 cells again; the m0500-m0401 agent need not override it, and where both windows override the same keyframe the first window in order (mine) wins.

keyframe_overrides/1 (wu_-550, -550..-481) starts in this window but runs on into m0500-m0401; Wu gets the Xu heartland back through wu/ledger/2 in -512, and the -480 keyframe snap is the next window's.

Seam for m0500-m0401: achaemenid-empire_-500 still snaps in about 740 cells at -500 after my Baluchestan event (Matruh in Egypt 408, Al Butnan and Al Qubbah in Libya about 190: Cyrenaica and the Western Desert from Cliopatria's 500 outline); the Cyrenaica page dates the Persian seizure of the Pentapolis to 525, which the next agent or a dossier fix could place earlier.
Median override effect: Urartu now holds its 404 Turkish cells to -591 and the Medes receive all of them at -590 through kingdom-of-urartu/ledger/11; the Median Lydian contest at -590 is unchanged.

Pages used: Darius_the_Great (no usable text on eastern provinces), Drangiana, Gedrosia, Croesus, Wu_(state) (no border or Zhoulai), Xu_(state), Urartu, Qataban; rendered but did not view the -584 China and -501 Makran comparison images.
